points.description: Identifies N1 as the node that was never a leader in any of the three terms.
points.partial_credit: Half if N1 is named but the answer also wrongly names other nodes as never leaders, or if the answer is unclear.

points.description: Justifies by showing the other nodes' logs are consistent with being leaders: N4 (a,b,c) for term 1, N3 (a,b,p,q,r,s) for term 2, N2 (a,b,p,q,x,y,z) for term 3. N1's log lacks r, s (term 2 entries) and z, so it cannot be the leader of any term (a leader's log holds all entries of its own term, and N1 has a partial term 2 and term 3 log).
points.partial_credit: Half if only some of the nodes are matched to terms, or the reasoning for N1 is vague.

rubric.notes: Full marks: N1 named as never a leader, with a justification that N4, N3 and N2 fit as leaders of terms 1, 2 and 3 from their logs. Part marks: the correct node with weak or partial justification, or a justification that is right but the final node is unclear. No marks: any other node named, or no valid reasoning.
